name: Kishii
body:
Kishii CR 8

Kishii (singular and plural) bear the visage of an attractive male humanoid on one side of their head and the visage of a hyena on the other side.

XP 4,800
CE Medium fey
Init +7; Senses low-light vision, scent; Perception +21
Aura aura of allure (30 ft., DC 18)

DEFENSE

AC 21, touch 14, flat-footed 17 (+3 Dex, +1 dodge, +7 natural)
hp 97 (13d6+52)
Fort +8, Ref +11, Will +11
DR 5/cold iron; Immune charm, disease

OFFENSE

Speed 50 ft.
Melee spear +14/+9 (1d8+12/x3 twohanded) and bite +10 (1d8+4) or bite +15 (1d8+12 plus tear)
Ranged spear +9 (1d8+8/x3)
Space 5 ft.; Reach 5 ft.
Special Attacks tear, seductive glance
Spell-Like Abilities (Cl 13th; concentration +15)

At will—dancing lights, light
3/day—charm person (DC 13), command (DC 13), detect desires (DC 15), suggestion (DC 15), unnatural lust (DC 14)
1/day—cacophonous call (DC 15), dominate person (DC 17), summon nature’s ally IV (hyenas only)

STATISTICS

Str 26, Dex 16, Con 19, Int 13, Wis 16, Cha 14
Base Atk +6; CMB +14; CMD 27
Feats Dodge, Improved Initiative, Improved Natural Armor, Improved Natural Attack, Run, Skill Focus (Perform [acting]), Weapon Focus (bite)
Skills Acrobatics +12, Bluff +6, Climb +12, Diplomacy +6, Disguise +12, Knowledge (geography) +10, Knowledge (local) +10, Knowledge (nature) +12, Perception +21, Perform (acting) +21, Sense Motive +18, Stealth +21, Survival +10, Swim +12; Racial Modifiers +4 Perception, +4 Stealth
Languages Aklo, Common, Sylvan
Sq erotic mannerisms, rotate head, sweet talker

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Aura Of Allure (Su)

A kishii is surrounded by an aura of allure that causes humanoids to react favorably towards it.

The first time a humanoid creature enters this aura, the humanoid must make a DC 18 Will saving throw. On a failed save, the humanoid becomes susceptible to the kishii’s desires and is hesitant to mar the kishii’s attractive physique. The humanoid takes a -2 penalty on their saving throws against the kishii’s spell-like abilities and a -2 penalty on their attack rolls against the kishii. Any humanoid that successfully saves against this aura gains immunity to it for the next 24 hours. This is a mind-affecting effect. The save DC is Charisma-based.

Erotic Mannerisms (Ex)

A kishii can hide the fact that he is using a spell-like ability, appearing to be moving erotically instead. As part of casting a spell, the kishii makes a Perform (acting) check DC 25 + the spell’s level. On a successful check, onlookers are unaware that the kishii just cast a spell.

Rotate Head (Ex)

A kishii can swivel its head around to display its alternate hyena face as a free action.

Seductive Glance (Su)

1/d As a standard action, the kishii can look into the eyes of a humanoid within 30 feet to curse it.

The targeted humanoid must make a successful DC 18 Will save or treat the kishii as a beloved companion and ally, forsaking all previous allies in favor of the kishii. The curse lasts for 1 hour or until the creature is cured with remove curse. The kishii must use this ability on a creature before it has revealed its hyena face to that creature, otherwise, the creature gains immunity to this ability. The save is Charisma-based.

Sweet Talker (Ex)

When making a Bluff or Diplomacy skill check, a kishii can use his bonus in the Perform (acting) skill instead.

Tear (Ex)

When a kishii uses its bite as a primary attack, it tears the wound open on a successful hit, dealing an additional 2d8 slashing damage and 1d8 bleed damage.

ECOLOGY

Environment warm deserts, warm forests (jungle), warm plains
Organization solitary
Treasure standard

Kishii were not always evil with a dual humanoid-hyena head. Much like a satyr, they appeared as a fit, attractive, humanoid male (minus the cloven feet and horns).

They were self-centered fey who enjoyed revelry, fornication, and self-indulgence.

One day, a kishii’s human mate discovered that the kishii betrayed their love for another. The human cursed the kishii for its duplicity with powerful magic. From that day forward, all kishii grew a hyena face on the back of their heads so people would see their devious, two-faced nature before it was too late.

Kishii enjoy one thing above all else—the hunt. Though capable of subsisting on carrion, kishii prefer the thrill of the chase, ending in a bloody feast. A kishii’s formidable strength and speed place it at the top of the food chain. Even big game like lions and tigers run from a kishii.

Kishii love a challenge and take perverse pleasure in seducing individuals into deserting their comrades in favor of the kishii. Most exhilarating for a kishii is witnessing the bewilderment and terror of a victim who believed the kishii to be their most cherished companion as the kishii rips its throat out.

Kishii typically hunt big game bareskinned, but when prowling for humanoid prey, they dress in fine clothing considered fashionable for the region. They always arrange their long locks to cover their hyena face and most often wear some type of headdress to conceal their dual nature.

Lost Atlanteans, Copyright 2024, Bloodstone Press; author Beth Jones
